editorial:
Imagine a guy who is just a few steps away from retiring, and his only official job is taking care of the police cars. That is Lam Kwok Kuen, a soft-hearted cop who spends his free time taking care of his son who has special needs. Even though he is not supposed to be out there chasing criminals, he has a heart of gold and a spirit that won't quit. You will feel for him as he balances the stress of fatherhood with a deep need to do the right thing. The vibe is a mix of a touching family story and a gritty police drama that keeps you rooting for the underdog.

You will love how the action hits hard and the acting feels real. The way he handles the bad guys is impressive, though some parts of the story move a bit slow. If you enjoy movies about honest heroes who get overlooked, this one is for you. To get the best experience, you should look for a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for those sharp action scenes. If you are in a rush, renting it on Apple TV is a great way to see if you like the style before buying it.
endingExplained: In the end, the story wraps up with a heavy emotional punch. After facing dangerous criminals and putting his life on the line, the hero proves that true bravery isn't about your rank. He successfully cleans up the streets, but the real victory is the bond he shares with his son. He finds peace knowing he did his duty and protected his family, ending the movie on a bittersweet but hopeful note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about unsung heroes and family bonds.
